source_acquisition.search_note: PDF p.1 explicitly links apple/ml-pararnn; OpenReview metadata and the title-matching README link the same repository to this paper. unicli search identified gh repo/search surfaces and agent-reach doctor reported the authenticated gh backend as available with a warning. gh repo view and the recursive main-tree inspection found README.md, Python package modules and CUDA kernels but no plot/figure/visual/table generator, notebook, TeX/TikZ/PGF/SVG, rendered asset, or experiment-data file. corpus/visual_sources/iclr-2026-49937f5dcda4/ is absent. The PDF remains the sole visual source; no weights or datasets were fetched.

paper_style.palette_strategy: PDF charts use a restrained categorical palette: blue #0072B2 for ParaGRU/diagonal variants, green #3A8C52 for ParaLSTM/block-diagonal variants, yellow #E69F00 for Mamba, and purple #594C80 for Transformer. Opacity/line weight encodes implementation or sequence-length conditions; Appendix D schematics add blue/red/green/orange block fills.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: pdfimages -list reports no embedded raster images; all inspected Figure/Table objects are vector paths and embedded text in the PDF. All object-bearing pages (1, 8–10, 15, 18–23, 27) were rendered at 200 dpi (1700×2200 PNG) and visually inspected. pdffonts confirms embedded Computer Modern, Nimbus Roman No9 L and NimbusMonL families.
paper_style.style_consistency: The paper uses two-column ICLR proceedings layout, booktabs-like horizontal rules for tables, serif page/caption typography and log-scaled timing/memory charts. Charts consistently use blue/green/yellow/purple roles and light gray plotting backgrounds; line weight often carries an implementation or chunk-size dimension. The main visual gap is that several color-heavy plots have no uncertainty encoding and captions defer setup details to nearby prose.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Timing results for the parallel reduction operations Alg. 1b (left), and the full parallel RNN application Alg. 1a (right), applied to sequences of varying length. Colors refer to different variants of the solvers: for diagonal Jacobians (blue, used by ParaGRU) and 2x2 block-diagonal ones (green, used by ParaLSTM). Heavier lines refer to progressively more efficient implementations: in PyTorch, in CUDA, and (for the RNN forward pass) with the fully-fused CUDA kernel. For reference, equivalent timing results for Mamba are also included (yellow). Actual speedup measurements reported in the main text refer to L = 2^9 (highlighted).

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色系表示 diagonal/ParaGRU，绿色系表示 2×2 block-diagonal/ParaLSTM，黄色表示 Mamba；线宽表示 PyTorch、CUDA、fused 实现层级。

encodings.text: ∼log L 指引与 L=2^9 speedup reference

figures.data_and_statistics: 左 panel 比较 diagonal 与 2×2 block-diagonal Jacobian 的 PyTorch/CUDA reduction 及 Mamba scan；右 panel 比较 ParaGRU、ParaLSTM 的 CUDA/fused forward 与 Mamba。两轴为 log，L 跨不同范围；A100 CUDA Events 使用 20 次 warm-up、100 次随机输入测量并取最小 timing，图面不显示方差。
figures.evidence_relation: Algorithm 1b 的 parallel reduction 与 Algorithm 1a 的 Newton outer loop → Figure 2 的实现层级和序列长度 regime → §5.1 的 L=2^9 speedup → Appendix Figures 5–8 的 modality/chunk-size 展开。
design_strengths: 同一页将 solver kernel 和完整 RNN forward 对齐，方法接口到系统成本的映射清晰。
线宽、颜色、panel 位置共同编码实现层级，legend 对关键语义有解释。
log–log 视图使容量受限后的 regime 变化可见。
design_weaknesses: 图内没有明确的重复/误差编码，最小 timing 对偶然最快运行较敏感。
图例在两 panel 分开，颜色与线宽组合较多，灰度输出难以保留全部身份。
caption 提到 highlighted L=2^9，但视觉高亮很弱，读者仍需回到正文查 speedup 定义。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用同一 x 轴 sweep 把“抽象求解器”和“完整前向”并排，并以颜色表示结构、线宽表示优化阶段；把选定 operating point 用清晰参考线或标记固定下来。

无不确定性、seed 数、平滑/异常值处理说明，稳定性结论只能是定性。
两 panel y 范围不同，caption 未提醒不能直接比较垂直高度。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将训练和验证曲线分为固定双 panel，保留采样频率和原始噪声；同时报告 seeds、平滑规则与最终数值表，避免把视觉平滑当作稳定性证据。

figures.label: Figure 12

caption.text: Figure 12: Schematics drafting the evolution of the target block bi-diagonal system (3) as it undergoes the first stage of our algorithm. Light-blue squares represent its main diagonal (i.e., identity matrices), while the dark-blue once represent the Jacobians at different l’s. Threads independently apply forward substitution to chunk size(= 3 in the figure) equations. At each step, this amounts to using equation l to reduce the following one l + 1 (i.e., applying lines 4 and 5 in Alg. 1b). Notice this makes all equations in a chunk depend on the value of the very first unknown, as exemplified by the progressive shift towards the left of the sub-diagonal block. At the end of this stage, we can effectively extract a simplified system involving only the last equation of each chunk, which is then passed onto the next stage.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝方块是主对角 identity，深蓝方块是 Jacobian；红/粉色轮廓和箭头表示 thread-level reduction 的逐步消元，黑色虚线分隔层级。

encodings.line: solid reduction arrows; dotted stage separators
encodings.facet: three matrix states: target → Step 1 → Step 2
encodings.text: Thread 1–4, Step 1/2, Thread-level reduction, To warp-level reduction

figures.data_and_statistics: 这是 Eq. (3) block bi-diagonal system 的算法示意，非实验数据。示例 chunk size=3；每个 thread 对 chunk 内方程做 forward substitution，使后续方程依赖 chunk 首个 unknown，并抽取每个 chunk 的最后方程交给下一阶段。
figures.evidence_relation: Eq. (3) 目标系统与 Algorithm 1b lines 4–5 → Figure 12 的 thread-level reduction → Figure 13 的 warp/block-level reduction → Appendix D.2 的 hierarchical GPU solver 叙述。
design_strengths: 按 target→two reduction steps 展示矩阵如何简化，机制方向比一张静态矩阵更清楚。
箭头、阶段标签和 block 位移共同表达消元过程。
caption 说明 chunk size 与 Alg. 1b 行号，便于回到伪代码。
design_weaknesses: 矩阵方块、红色 overlay 和 dotted separators 密集，单栏缩放后细节难以复核。
identity/Jacobian 主要依赖颜色，caption 才提供语义 key，灰度可读性有限。
这是算法机制图，没有与 Figure 2 的 timing 或复杂度量化对接。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用连续矩阵状态展示并行消元的局部到全局层级，配合明确的 block legend、线程粒度和下一阶段接口；最好附一份可放大的源图或定量复杂度标注。

figures.label: Figure 13

caption.text: Figure 13: Schematics drafting the evolution of the simplified block bi-diagonal system stemming from thread-level reduction, as it undergoes the second stage of our algorithm. The threads within a same warp (8 in the figure, but 32 in practice) apply parallel reduction to further simplify the target system. At each step i, this amounts to using equation l to reduce the l + 2^i -th one. Notice this progressively shifts the sub-diagonal blocks by 2^0, 2^1, 2^2, . . . positions, until all equations depend only on the very first unknown in the warp. At the end of this stage, we can effectively extract a simplified system involving only the last equation of each warp, which is then passed onto the next stage. At the block level, the algorithm proceeds similarly: the last threads of each warp perform parallel reduction, operating on the simplified system.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/灰方块是简化系统，红色方块与箭头表示 warp 内 reduction，绿色表示 warp-level stage，橙色表示转入 block-level reduction；阶段标签和块位置提供冗余。

figures.data_and_statistics: 这是 thread-level reduction 后的简化 block bi-diagonal system 的 warp/block 层级算法示意；图中 warp 规模为 8、实际为 32，按 l+2^i 连接逐步消元，最终抽取每个 warp 的最后方程再进入 block-level。无样本或统计量。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 12 输出的 per-chunk system → Figure 13 的 warp-level parallel reduction 与 block-level hand-off → Appendix D.2 的 shared-memory/synchronization 说明 → Figure 2 的 kernel scaling。
design_strengths: 把 2^0、2^1、2^2 位移和多级 reduction 画成连续状态，机制层级易于跟踪。
阶段颜色与文字标签共同表达 warp→block hand-off。
caption 明确图示 warp size 与实践 warp size 的差别。
design_weaknesses: 四个状态和大量 colored blocks 在页面下半部较拥挤，方块标签不可放大阅读。
颜色承担 warp/block 角色，灰度下需要依赖阶段位置和箭头。
caption 仍依赖 Eq. (3)/前图语境，不能独立说明每个矩阵块的数学含义。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将层级并行 reduction 画成 block-offset 的 step sequence，明确图示规模与实际硬件规模，并用同一箭头/颜色规范连接 Figure 12。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Single-layer accuracy on synthetic tasks. ()† denotes results computed training only the RNN cell (see App. C.2 for details).

tables.uncertainty: Accuracy percentages are point estimates. Three seeds are run in Appendix C.2 but the best result is retained; no mean, spread, interval or failure count is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: 六个 single-layer model rows（LSTM、GRU、ParaLSTM、ParaGRU、Mamba2、Transformer）与九个 synthetic-task columns；task headers include n、κ、k、C、M、|V| conditions. Accuracy uses whole-percent values, so the displayed precision is 0 decimals.
tables.evidence_relation: §5.2 关于 nonlinear expressivity 与 diagonal-Jacobian limitation → Table 1 的 task-by-model comparison → Appendix C.2 task definitions/training details → A5 failure and full-Jacobian control interpretation.
design_strengths: 把 vanilla full-Jacobian control、Para variants、linear Mamba 与 Transformer 放在同一 decision surface。
多行表头保留每个 task 的关键参数，避免只有缩写。
分组横线突出“full Jacobian control vs constrained/linear alternatives”。
design_weaknesses: caption 没有逐项解释九个任务，脱离 Appendix C.2 很难判断 retrieval/state-tracking 含义。
没有 seed dispersion，且“best result”隐藏了跨 seed 的选择效应。
10 列紧凑排版导致 task header、† 和 A5 等小文字可读性弱。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用任务条件作为二级表头，把能力覆盖与失败案例并列；若报告多 seed，应增加 mean/spread 或明确 best-of-seeds 选择规则。

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Perplexity, parameters count, and evaluation scores on lm-eval-harness (Gao et al., 2021) tasks, for 7B models. Accuracies in percentages. Shot counts are reported in brackets.

tables.uncertainty: PPL and downstream task accuracies are point estimates for approximately 7B models; no seeds, uncertainty, calibration or failure counts are shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows are Mamba2, ParaLSTM, ParaGRU, Transformer; columns are Model, #params, ↓PPL, Arc-C (25/3), HSwag (10/0), OBQA (10/0), WinoG (5/0), PiQA (0), MMLU (0). Metrics display two decimals; #params is a mixed M/B string.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 1 PPL headline → Table 2 7B downstream decision → Appendix Table 6 all-scale expansion → conclusion that Mamba2 leads while Para cells remain competitive.
design_strengths: A single wide table jointly shows quality (PPL/accuracy) and parameter scale.
Direction arrows and shot subheaders make task evaluation conditions compact but explicit.
The four rows support the ordering discussed immediately below the table.
design_weaknesses: Task abbreviations are not expanded in the caption; the lm-eval harness context and exact dataset versions remain external.
No uncertainty or run aggregation makes close differences (for example ParaGRU vs ParaLSTM) hard to interpret.
Wide 13-column layout compresses headers and makes scan order costly.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use grouped task headers with direction arrows and shot subcolumns to place model quality and scale on one surface; state benchmark version and aggregation rule in the caption.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Throughput results at regime (L = 2^11) for the model types and sizes considered.

tables.uncertainty: Tokens/s point estimates at L=2^11; the Figure 3 inference protocol uses five repetitions and reports minimum timing, but no variance or seed aggregation is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four model rows (ParaGRU, ParaLSTM, Mamba2, Transformer) and four scale columns (400M, 1B, 3B, 7B) plus Model. Values use two decimals. The 3B label is retained exactly as printed even though other appendix tables use 2.9B.
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 3 1B generation curve → Table 3 scale-specific throughput → Figure 9 memory and Table 4 architecture/cost context; it tests whether recurrent constant-token cost persists across size.
design_strengths: Very compact scale sweep makes the recurrent-versus-Transformer gap immediately visible.
The fixed L condition is in the caption and the model rows match the main figures.
design_weaknesses: “at regime” is vague and no hardware/time aggregation appears in the caption.
3B versus 2.9B naming differs across tables and is not explained.
No uncertainty or per-model parameter count prevents cost-normalized interpretation.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a narrow scale-by-model matrix for throughput, but bind the sequence length, hardware, repetitions and naming convention directly to the caption.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Architecture specifications and optimal hyperparameters for our experiments. We report structural parameters (number of layers, number of heads and model width) and training hyperparameters (learning rate and weight decay) that achieved lowest perplexity for each model type and scale. Time measurements show average single-step training cost on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, while Memory measurements show the per-sample peak memory usage during one optimization step.

tables.uncertainty: Time is average single-step cost on NVIDIA H100; memory is per-sample peak during one optimization step. No SD/SE or run count is listed.
tables.data_and_statistics: Sixteen rows are four model types × four scales. Columns: Model type, #params, n_layers, n_heads, d_model, learning rate, weight decay, ↓Time [ms/step], ↓Memory [GiB/sample]. Precision is mixed: scientific notation for LR/WD, integer structural fields and one-decimal costs, so no single decimal precision applies.
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix C.1 training setup → Table 4 architecture/hyperparameter and cost contract → Figure 10 block structure → Figure 11 loss trajectories and Table 6 outcomes.
design_strengths: One table binds architecture, optimization choices and operational costs, which is valuable for reproduction.
Four scale groups make depth/width changes and cost growth inspectable.
Explicit units and direction arrows help distinguish resource columns from model quality.
design_weaknesses: Mixed units and precision make column scanning slow; no grouped header visually separates structure, training and cost.
Average/peak definitions omit timing repetitions and memory measurement protocol.
The 7B Mamba2 time outlier needs context that is only in prose, not a visual highlight.
tables.reusable_pattern: Group structural, training and cost columns into three visual blocks, retain scale row groups, and report aggregation/replicate rules beside average and peak quantities.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Scale-specific training configurations on nodes with 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs each All models use 2048-token sequences and follow (∼ 1×) Chinchilla-optimal token budgets (Hoffmann et al., 2022) for batch-size selection. The z-loss regularization coefficient is taken from DCLM (Li et al., 2024).

tables.uncertainty: Configuration table rather than a stochastic estimate; no uncertainty applies. Counts, coefficient, iterations and token budgets are deterministic settings.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows are 400M, 1B, 2.9B, 7B; columns are Model Scale, Nodes, Batch Size per GPU, Effective Batch Size, Z-Loss, Total Iterations, Warm-up Iterations, Training Tokens [B]. Precision is mixed across counts, scientific notation and one-decimal token budgets.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 4 architecture choices → Table 5 node/batch/token budget → Figure 11 training/validation sampling and loss → Table 6 all-scale evaluation.
design_strengths: Caption gives the shared 2048-token and Chinchilla context so the compact row matrix is interpretable.
Effective batch size and warm-up are placed beside total iterations, supporting reproduction.
design_weaknesses: Caption punctuation is cramped (“each All models”), and no visual grouping distinguishes hardware, optimization and token budget.
No wall-clock duration, throughput or failed-run information is included.
z-loss source is named but its role and units are not visible in the table.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a small scale configuration matrix with explicit shared-condition caption and separate hardware, batch, schedule and token-budget column groups.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6: Final perplexities, and evaluation scores on reference downstream tasks from lm-eval-harness (Gao et al., 2021), for all model types and scales considered.

tables.uncertainty: Final PPL and downstream accuracies are point estimates; no seed, uncertainty, confidence interval, failure value or aggregate across runs is shown.
tables.data_and_statistics: Sixteen rows (four model types × four scales) and thirteen columns: Model, #params, ↓PPL, Arc-C (25/3), HSwag (10/0), OBQA (10/0), WinoG (5/0), PiQA (0), and MMLU (0). Two decimals are used for PPL and accuracy; parameter labels mix M/B.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 7B slice → Table 6 all-scale expansion → Figure 1 PPL bars and Figure 11 training curves → claim that RNN quality improves with scale while Mamba2 remains strongest PPL.
design_strengths: Complete scale expansion preserves the same model/task order as Table 2, enabling direct lookup.
Scale row groups and shot subheaders provide a high-density but regular comparison surface.
The table supplies exact values that the small main Figure 1 bars cannot show.
design_weaknesses: Thirteen columns and 16 rows are hard to scan at appendix size; no alternating group shading or bold best values is used.
The caption does not expand task abbreviations or state shot semantics beyond the headers.
Point estimates and best-run selection context are absent, so small cross-model differences are not calibrated.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep a full-scale appendix table as the numeric source of truth while linking each scale group to a compact main-figure summary; add explicit aggregation and benchmark metadata.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 establishes the speed/PPL headline. Figure 2 decomposes the parallel solver and full forward pass, Figure 3 extends the runtime claim to generation, and Table 1/2 tests expressivity and 7B language-model quality. Appendix Figures 4–9 diagnose convergence, modality, chunk-size and memory costs; Figure 10 exposes the language-model block; Figure 11 checks training dynamics; Figures 12–13 visualize the solver hierarchy. Tables 3–6 supply scale throughput, configuration, budget and exact all-scale scores.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions consistently name the object and, for Figures 2 and 5–8, define color/line-weight encodings. Figure 1 and Figure 3 captions are short and headline-oriented; Figure 10 is title-only; Figures 12–13 carry long mechanism explanations. Setup and uncertainty are often in nearby prose or Appendix cross-references rather than repeated in the caption.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables use multi-line serif headers, ↑/↓ direction arrows, parenthesized shot/task conditions and scale row groups. Tables 1/2/6 use dense task metric headers; Tables 4/5 separate architecture or training settings. Booktabs-style horizontal rules dominate, with Table 4 adding a partial vertical cost separator.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Algorithm 1 and Eq. (3) define Newton plus hierarchical parallel reduction; Figures 2, 5–8 show implementation consequences; Table 1 exposes the diagonal-Jacobian expressivity limitation; Figure 9 checks predicted memory scaling. The link is strongest where a parameter or structure has a plotted sweep, and weakest for single point-estimate language-model tables.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–2 provide the decision surface. Appendix Figures 4–9 and 11 plus Tables 3–6 expand the same claims with convergence, implementation modes, scale, memory, training configuration and all-scale score slices. Figure 10 and Figures 12–13 are method interfaces that make the implementation readable but are not quantitative evidence.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Embedded PDF objects use Nimbus Roman No9 L, Computer Modern math and NimbusMonL in the proceedings; chart and table labels remain visually aligned with the serif paper style. Estimated chart text is about 5.5–9 pt, with captions/body around 9–10 pt; small multi-column headers and legends are the main legibility pressure points.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Blue/green/yellow/purple model roles persist from Figure 1 through Figures 3, 5–8, 11 and Tables 2/6 headers. Lighter shades and line width denote implementation or L conditions, while Appendix D introduces a separate block-reduction semantic palette. Color is partially redundant through position, labels and line weight, but Figures 3, 9 and 11 remain color-dependent in grayscale.

most_reusable_patterns: 将 efficiency curve 与 quality bar/table 并置，先给出数量级成本，再给出模型质量和规模条件。
用固定结构的双 panel sweep 对照 implementation modality、Jacobian type、cell family 或 memory variable，并让颜色/线宽各承担一个明确维度。
用完整 appendix tables 保留精确数值，以 main figure 提供趋势和 operating-point headline；caption 明确单位、条件和比较对象。
对算法机制采用 target→step-state 的矩阵序列图，把局部线程、warp 和 block 的 hand-off 连起来。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：最有效地把 speedup 与 7B/多尺度 PPL 放在同一视觉入口。
Figure 2：将 Algorithm 1a/1b 的 solver 层级映射到 sequence-length timing，是方法到系统证据的关键桥接。
Table 1：同时呈现 nonlinear expressivity、full-Jacobian control 和 A5 failure，保留了主张边界。
Figure 4 与 Figure 9：分别检验 N_its=3 的收敛经验和 O(Ld_h) memory 预测，但应配套更明确的不确定性/斜率信息。
failure_patterns: 多条曲线依赖蓝/绿/黄/紫及浅色透明度，灰度和色觉受限时识别成本高。
Figure 1/3/10 等 caption 过短，硬件、模型规模、重复/聚合规则和 panel 语义需要回正文查找。
runtime、PPL、accuracy、memory 多为 point estimate，缺少 seed/repetition dispersion、error bar 或 failure accounting。
密集 multi-column tables 与 appendix mechanism diagrams 在页面缩放后难以逐项读取，且少数命名/单位需依赖正文解释。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以统一的蓝绿黄紫模型语义和 log-scaled cost plots，从 Figure 1 的 speed/quality headline 经 Figure 2–3 的 runtime consequence、Table 1–2 的 expressivity/LM decision，再由附录的 convergence、kernel ablation、memory、training configuration 和 solver diagrams 闭合 ParaRNN 的“可并行、可训练、但受结构与 point-estimate 边界约束”视觉论证。
